canonical_selector.rule: This is the only current-work selector. The checkpoint named by this pointer is the only current work-state projection.

work_state.rule: Only the checkpoint named by CURRENT_WORK_POINTER.json is CURRENT. Directory presence never selects work.

selection_invariants: An open PR, branch or unselected checkpoint does not select current work.
